title: Two Futures Face Off in Brazil

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin, and I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs, in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶时代，每晚你都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个充满活力的、犹如50年前精美艺术品的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在，请在您喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: On Sunday, voters in Brazil will cast their votes in a presidential race that is widely seen as the most important election there in decades.
sentences.zh: 周日，巴西选民将在总统选举中投下选票，这次选举被普遍认为是该国几十年来最重要的一次大选。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Jack Nickus, about the two larger-than-life candidates in the race, and why the future of Brazilian democracy is on the ballot.
sentences.zh: 我与我的同事杰克·尼克斯谈论了这场竞选中的两位极具传奇色彩的候选人，以及为什么巴西民主的未来正悬于选票之上。

sentences.en: It's Friday, October 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月28日，星期五。

sentences.en: So, Jack, I'm in the U.S., where a midterm election is kind of in full swing at this point, two weeks away.
sentences.zh: 那么，杰克，我在美国，这里的期中选举正进行得如火如荼，还有两周就要举行了。

sentences.en: You're in Brazil, and you are also covering an election, a presidential election.
sentences.zh: 你在巴西，你也在报道一场选举，一场总统选举。

sentences.en: Tell me about the stakes of that conteSt.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲这场竞选的利害关系吧。

sentences.en: Well, I think this is arguably the biggest election in Latin America in decades.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这可以说是拉丁美洲几十年里规模最大的选举。

sentences.en: Brazil is by far the largest country in population in Latin America, and it is also the largest economy.
sentences.zh: 就人口而言，巴西是拉丁美洲当之无愧的最大国家，同时它也是最大的经济体。

sentences.en: But it is a country that's really been struggling.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个一直在苦苦挣扎的国家。

sentences.en: You know, 10 years ago, Brazil was really thought to be ascendant.
sentences.zh: 你知道，10年前，巴西曾被认为正在崛起。

sentences.en: Brazil's economy has been going through a boom for years.
sentences.zh: 巴西经济已经经历了几年的繁荣。

sentences.en: But since then…
sentences.zh: 但自那以后……

sentences.en: Well, Brazil faces a number of real challenges at the moment.
sentences.zh: 嗯，巴西目前面临着许多现实挑战。

sentences.en: The economy has flatlined.
sentences.zh: 经济停滞不前。

sentences.en: Brazil has one of the lowest GDP forecasts in the region.
sentences.zh: 巴西是该地区GDP预测增长率最低的国家之一。

sentences.en: There's been a ton of political turmoil.
sentences.zh: 政治动荡层出不穷。

sentences.en: Brazil's president, Jair Bolsonaro, has been lashing out at the country's media after stories over a corruption scandal.
sentences.zh: 在有关腐败丑闻的报道爆出后，巴西总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗一直在猛烈抨击该国的媒体。

sentences.en: And…
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: Lines of hungry people waiting for a meal.
sentences.zh: 排队等待施舍食物的饥饿人群。

sentences.en: We're now even seeing the return of hunger in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 我们现在甚至看到了饥饿在巴西的重现。

sentences.en: President Jair Bolsonaro acknowledged that Brazilians are struggling with the state of the economy.
sentences.zh: 总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗承认，巴西人正在艰难应对当前的经济状况。

sentences.en: And it is now deciding between two of the biggest political figures in the modern history of Brazilian politics.
sentences.zh: 而现在，这场选举将在巴西现代政治史上的两位最具影响力的政治人物之间做出抉择。

sentences.en: So a highly consequential election here in Brazil…
sentences.zh: 因此，这在巴西是一场极其重要的选举……

sentences.en: These are two essentially populists, one from the left and one from the right,
sentences.zh: 这两个人本质上都是民粹主义者，一个来自左翼，一个来自右翼，

sentences.en: who represent very different visions for the country and who want to take the country in very different directions.
sentences.zh: 他们代表了对国家截然不同的愿景，并希望将国家带向完全不同的方向。

sentences.en: And they have run a campaign that has gotten rather ugly.
sentences.zh: 他们的竞选活动已经变得相当丑陋。

sentences.en: And things have really tightened in recent weeks.
sentences.zh: 最近几周，选情真的变得异常胶着。

sentences.en: And it's now looking like a potential toss-up.
sentences.zh: 现在看来结果很难预料，胜负难分。

sentences.en: The eyes of the world watching what happens here in tomorrow's election.
sentences.zh: 全世界的目光都在注视着明天这里将发生什么。

sentences.en: Okay, so two populists, one on the left and one on the right.
sentences.zh: 好吧，也就是两个民粹主义者，一个左翼，一个右翼。

sentences.en: Tell me about them.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲他们吧。

sentences.en: Who are they?
sentences.zh: 他们是谁？

sentences.en: So on the left, we have Luis Inacio Lula da Silva, who is universally known as simply Lula.
sentences.zh: 在左翼，我们有路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦，大家都普遍简称为卢拉。
zh_words: 路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦

sentences.en: He's 77 years old, and he's a former president.
sentences.zh: 他今年77岁，曾任总统。

sentences.en: And he is one of the most famous and important political figures in Latin American history.
sentences.zh: 他是拉丁美洲历史中最著名、最重要的政治人物之一。

sentences.en: And that is in part because he has this really incredible political story.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是他有着一段极其不可思议的政治人生经历。

sentences.en: So he grows up in Brazil's poor northeast in the 1950s in a shack with no electricity and no plumbing.
sentences.zh: 他在20世纪50年代长大于巴西贫困的东北部，住在一间没有电也没有自来水的棚屋里。

sentences.en: His parents are illiterate farm workers.
sentences.zh: 他的父母是不识字的农场工人。

sentences.en: He didn't learn to read until he was about 10 years old.
sentences.zh: 他直到10岁左右才学会认字。

sentences.en: And he leaves school after the fifth grade.
sentences.zh: 他在五年级后便辍学了。

sentences.en: Now, eventually, he moves to Sao Paulo and starts working in a factory.
sentences.zh: 后来，他搬到圣保罗并在一家工厂开始工作。

sentences.en: And there, he loses a finger in an accident.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他在一次事故中失去了一根手指。

sentences.en: And, you know, even to this day, his nine fingers have become a sort of symbol of his working class identity.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，直到今天，他的九根手指已经成了他工人阶级身份的一种象征。

sentences.en: Now, as a factory worker, he becomes connected to the labor movement.
sentences.zh: 作为一名工厂工人，他开始与劳工运动建立联系。

sentences.en: So connected that he eventually rises to become the leader of one of the country's biggest unions.
sentences.zh: 联系如此紧密，以至于他最终崭露头角，成为了该国最大工会之一的领袖。

sentences.en: And then from that position, he goes on to create a political party, the Workers' Party, and begins running for political office.
sentences.zh: 凭借这一地位，他进而创建了一个政党——劳工党，并开始竞选公职。

sentences.en: And over the next several decades, he and the Workers' Party become one of the most powerful political forces in Brazil, if not the moSt.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几十年里，他和劳工党成为了巴西最具权势的政治力量之一，甚至可以说是最强大的。

sentences.en: And eventually, in 2002, he's elected president.
sentences.zh: 最终，在2002年，他当选为总统。

sentences.en: And what did Lula do as president?
sentences.zh: 卢拉当总统时都做了些什么？

sentences.en: I mean, what did he become known for?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他因何而闻名？

sentences.en: So Lula was elected to lead a country that had long been seen as a nation that had tremendous potential, but really had never lived up to that potential.
sentences.zh: 卢拉当选时领导的是一个长期被视为拥有巨大潜力、但从未真正兑现过这种潜力的国家。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he's arriving at a time when Brazil is just 17 years removed from the end of a brutal military dictatorship.
sentences.zh: 他上台时，巴西刚刚结束长达17年的残酷军事独裁统治。

sentences.en: So it's a relatively new democracy.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个相对年轻的民主国家。

sentences.en: It's still dealing with some growing pains.
sentences.zh: 它仍在应对成长中的阵痛。

sentences.en: You know, it's trying to find its place in the world.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它在试图寻找自己在世界上的位置。

sentences.en: But Lula arrives at a time where actually there was some real economic tailwinds, and he was able to take advantage of that.
sentences.zh: 但卢拉上台时，恰逢出现了一些真正的经济顺风，而他成功地利用了这一点。

sentences.en: And what were they, the tailwinds?
sentences.zh: 那么，这些顺风是什么呢？

sentences.en: So China had just entered the World Trade Organization in 2001 and was industrializing itself and had an enormous appetite for commodities.
sentences.zh: 中国刚于2001年加入世界贸易组织，正在进行工业化进程，对大宗商品有着巨大的胃口。

sentences.en: And Brazil had an enormous supply.
sentences.zh: 而巴西拥有巨大的供应量。

sentences.en: It is a huge supplier of soybeans, iron ore, meat, a lot of things that China wanted.
sentences.zh: 它是大豆、铁矿石、肉类以及中国所需许多物资的巨大供应国。

sentences.en: So he was able to create a really important economic relationship with China at that time and with many other countries to really lift Brazil's finances to,
sentences.zh: 因此，他在当时能够与中国以及许多其他国家建立起非常重要的经济关系，从而使巴西的财政扶摇直上，

sentences.en: over the course of administration, become the sixth largest economy in the world, which was a huge improvement for the country.
sentences.zh: 在他的政府任期内，巴西成为了全球第六大经济体，这对该国来说是一个巨大的飞跃。

sentences.en: During his administration, Brazil also discovered offshore oil, which was another windfall for Lula.
sentences.zh: 在他的任期内，巴西还发现了近海石油，这给卢拉带来了又一笔横财。

sentences.en: He famously said at the time that God is Brazilian.
sentences.zh: 他当时有一句名言：上帝是巴西人。

sentences.en: And as a result of these financial successes, he had a lot more money to play with.
sentences.zh: 由于这些财务上的成功，他有了更多的资金可以调配。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And he used that to kind of remake Brazil in a way.
sentences.zh: 他用这些资金在某种程度上重塑了巴西。

sentences.en: He oversaw enormous investments in infrastructure and education, a large expansion of the social welfare state.
sentences.zh: 他监督了对基础设施和教育的大规模投资，并大幅扩张了社会福利国家。

sentences.en: And over his eight years, he was able to lift about 20 million Brazilians out of extreme poverty.
sentences.zh: 在他执政的八年里，他成功使大约2000万巴西人摆脱了极端贫困。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was roughly a tenth of the country.
sentences.zh: 是的，大约占全国人口的十分之一。

sentences.en: He also was successful in lifting Brazil on the international stage.
sentences.zh: 他在提升巴西国际地位方面也取得了成功。

sentences.en: He was instrumental in getting the World Cup and the Olympics to come to Brazil, kind of seen as a coming out party for the country.
sentences.zh: 他在为巴西争取世界杯和奥运会举办权方面起到了关键作用，这被视为该国的成人礼。

sentences.en: And he was one of the driving forces in creating BRICS, which was this alliance of emerging economies with Russia, India, China and South Africa.
sentences.zh: 他是建立金砖国家（BRICS）的主要推动力之一，这是一个由俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非等新兴经济体组成的联盟。

sentences.en: So by the time he left office in 2010, he had an 80 percent approval rating, which is essentially unheard of.
sentences.zh: 因此，当他在2010年卸任时，他的支持率高达80%，这基本上是闻所未闻的。

sentences.en: And Obama even famously called him at an international meeting, quote, the most popular politician on earth.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马甚至在一次国际会议上称他为“地球上最受欢迎的政客”。

sentences.en: So it was a successful eight years.
sentences.zh: 所以那是成功的一八。

sentences.en: So he was beloved and lifted all of these people out of poverty and really gave Brazilians a sense of pride in their country, kind of put Brazil in a different place,
sentences.zh: 因此他深受爱戴，让所有人摆脱了贫困，真正赋予了巴西人对国家的自豪感，把巴西放在了一个不同的位置，

sentences.en: a higher place in the world.
sentences.zh: 一个在世界上更高的地方。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Lula and his workers' party were kind of on top of Brazilian politics.
sentences.zh: 卢拉和他的劳工党一度处于巴西政治的巅峰。

sentences.en: They seemingly couldn't lose.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎不可战胜。

sentences.en: And after he left in 2010, because of term limits, his handpicked successor was quickly elected to office.
sentences.zh: 2010年他因任期限制离任后，他亲自挑选的接班人很快就当选上台了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But then things started to change for the workers' party.
sentences.zh: 但随后，劳工党的情况开始发生变化。

sentences.en: And what happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, there were the economic issues.
sentences.zh: 首先，出现了经济问题。

sentences.en: Commodity prices dropped, which was obviously very bad for Brazil.
sentences.zh: 大宗商品价格下跌，这对巴西来说显然非常糟糕。

sentences.en: And Lula's successor, trying to protect the economy, intervened.
sentences.zh: 为了保护经济，卢拉的继任者进行了干预。

sentences.en: She cut taxes.
sentences.zh: 她削减了税收。

sentences.en: She imposed price controls and pressured banks on interest rates.
sentences.zh: 她实施了价格管制，并在利率问题上向银行施压。

sentences.en: And all of this backfired.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都适得其反。

sentences.en: It really just made things worse.
sentences.zh: 它实际上只是让事情变得更糟。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And around the same time, there was actually an even bigger problem for the workers' party.
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，对劳工党来说其实还有一个更大的问题。

sentences.en: And that's the revelation of an enormous corruption scheme that had played out for years deep inside the Brazilian government.
sentences.zh: 那就是曝光了一个在巴西政府内部深处运作了多年的巨额腐败丑闻。

sentences.en: But basically,
sentences.zh: 但基本上，

sentences.en: construction companies and Brazil's state-owned oil company had for years been paying out hundreds of millions of dollars of kickbacks to politicians and government officials in order to get public contracts.
sentences.zh: 建筑公司和巴西国有石油公司多年来一直向政客和政府官员支付数亿美元的回扣，以获取公共合同。

sentences.en: And a lot of that money went to Lula's key deputies and allies within the workers' party.
sentences.zh: 其中许多资金流向了卢拉在劳工党内的核心副手和盟友。

sentences.en: Nearly 300 people end up arrested in this corruption investigation.
sentences.zh: 近300人在这场腐败调查中被捕。

sentences.en: And eventually, prosecutors homed in on Lula himself.
sentences.zh: 最终，检察官将目标锁定在了卢拉本人身上。

sentences.en: In two separate cases, he was convicted of corruption.
sentences.zh: 在两起独立的案件中，他被判贪腐罪名成立。

sentences.en: In both cases, it involved construction companies either giving him a condo or making renovations to a home that allegedly was his.
sentences.zh: 这两起案件都涉及建筑公司向他提供一套公寓，或是对据称属于他的一处房产进行装修。

sentences.en: And eventually, he was sentenced to 22 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 最终，他被判处22年监禁。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So he went to jail.
sentences.zh: 所以他入狱了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, he's always maintained his innocence and kind of framed this as political opponents trying to prevent him from running for president again.
sentences.zh: 现在，他一直坚称自己无罪，并将此归咎于政治对手试图阻止他再次竞选总统。

sentences.en: Yet, there was enough evidence to convict him.
sentences.zh: 然而，证据确凿，足以定他的罪。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And after all is said and done, multiple companies are convicted under U.S.
sentences.zh: 尘埃落定之后，多家公司根据美国反腐败法被定罪。

sentences.en: anti-corruption practices law.
sentences.zh: 反腐败惯例法。

sentences.en: Billions of dollars are eventually paid in fines and returned to governments and investors.
sentences.zh: 最终支付了数十亿美元的罚款，并退还给政府和投资者。

sentences.en: And it's really a big black eye for Brazil.
sentences.zh: 这对巴西来说确实是一个极大的污点。

sentences.en: And yet, a lot of the population see it as a breath of fresh air.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多民众却认为这带来了一股清新的空气。

sentences.en: Because for the first time, they saw this as a rooting out of the corruption they had long suspected deep inside the Brazilian government.
sentences.zh: 因为他们生平第一次看到，这是在彻底铲除他们长期以来怀疑存在于巴西政府内部深处的腐败。

sentences.en: And in the wake of the investigation, one candidate in particular used that to his advantage.
sentences.zh: 在调查之后，有一位候选人特别利用了这一点来为自己谋利。

sentences.en: And that was Jair Bolsonaro.
sentences.zh: 那就是雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗。

sentences.en: So tell me about Bolsonaro.
sentences.zh: 那么跟我讲讲博尔索纳罗吧。

sentences.en: He's the current president of Brazil, of course, and we've talked about him a lot on the show.
sentences.zh: 他当然是巴西现任总统，我们在节目中经常讨论他。

sentences.en: But remind me of what we need to know about him.
sentences.zh: 但请提醒我一下，我们需要了解他什么。

sentences.en: So Bolsonaro is the other figure in this race that's going to be decided on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 博尔索纳罗是周日将要决出胜负的这场竞选中的另一位风云人物。

sentences.en: But when he first ran for president in 2018, he was already a character on the political scene.
sentences.zh: 但当他在2018年首次竞选总统时，他已经是政坛上的一个奇葩人物了。

sentences.en: He's a former army captain.
sentences.zh: 他曾是一名陆军上尉。

sentences.en: He had spent three decades in Congress, but was more known for saying offensive things on the far right of Brazilian society.
sentences.zh: 他在国会度过了三十年，但更为人所知的是在巴西社会的极右翼发表一些冒犯性言论。

sentences.en: You know, for instance, he once suggested to a rival lawmaker that she wasn't worthy of being raped.
sentences.zh: 你知道，例如，他曾向一位同僚女议员暗示她不配被强奸。

sentences.en: He also had said that he wouldn't be capable of loving a gay son.
sentences.zh: 他还曾说过自己无法去爱一个同性恋儿子。

sentences.en: So he made a lot of headlines for these sorts of things and wasn't really considered to be a serious politician.
sentences.zh: 因此他因这类言论上了很多头条新闻，并没有被真正视为一个严肃的政治家。

sentences.en: But in the presidential election of 2018, in the wake of this investigation, he arrived with this enormous political momentum.
sentences.zh: 但在2018年的总统大选中，在这场调查的余波中，他携带着巨大的政治势头登场了。

sentences.en: And that was in large part because he hammered on the corruption of the Workers' Party and of Lula and talked about how he would build a government that would further fight this corruption.
sentences.zh: 这在很大程度上是因为他猛烈抨击劳工党和卢拉的腐败，并谈到他将如何建立一个进一步打击这种腐败的政府。

sentences.en: And it worked with voters.
sentences.zh: 这招对选民很管用。

sentences.en: In 2018, he won the presidency.
sentences.zh: 2018年，他赢得了总统大选。

sentences.en: So in some ways, Lula's fall leads to his rise.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，卢拉的倒台促成了他的崛起。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he also took advantage of this sort of wider global right-wing populism that had lifted other candidates like Donald Trump to office.
sentences.zh: 他也利用了这种更广泛的全球右翼民粹主义，正是这种民粹主义把唐纳德·特朗普等其他候选人推上了总统宝座。

sentences.en: I was going to say, it sounds a lot like Donald Trump's candidacy.
sentences.zh: 我正想说，这听起来很像唐纳德·特朗普的竞选。

sentences.en: Completely.
sentences.zh: 完全如此。

sentences.en: Bolsonaro for a long time has been called the Trump of the tropics.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，博尔索纳罗一直被称为“热带特朗普”。

sentences.en: The Trump of the tropics.
sentences.zh: 热带特朗普。

sentences.en: I think the comparison is apt.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个比喻很贴切。

sentences.en: And like Trump, the four years of his first term were tumultuous.
sentences.zh: 和特朗普一样，他第一个任期的四年是动荡不安的。

sentences.en: Tell me about what happened.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲发生了什么。

sentences.en: What happened in his first term?
sentences.zh: 他的第一任期发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, he kind of came in with a scorched earth approach.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他上台时带有一种焦土政策般的态度。

sentences.en: He attacked the press, the judiciary, his political opponents, environmentalists, health professionals, many of his peers across Latin America.
sentences.zh: 他攻击新闻界、司法界、政敌、环保人士、卫生专业人员以及他在拉丁美洲的许多同僚。

sentences.en: But what I think is clearly the most notable thing that happened in his first term was that in his second year in office, the pandemic arrives.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他第一任期内最引人注目的事情，显然是他在任期第二年，疫情爆发了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Bolsonaro, you know, much like Trump, again, was someone who was very skeptical of the scientific consensus about social distancing and masks and even vaccines.
sentences.zh: 而且博索纳罗，你知道的，很像特朗普，同样对关于社交距离、口罩甚至是疫苗的科学共识持高度怀疑态度。

sentences.en: He was someone who promoted unproven drugs as a cure and someone who stalled in buying vaccines.
sentences.zh: 他宣传未经证实的药物作为疗法，并在购买疫苗方面拖拖拉拉。

sentences.en: And even today, he still refuses to say whether he has been vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 甚至直到今天，他仍然拒绝透露自己是否接种过疫苗。

sentences.en: In fact, his government has put his vaccination status under a hundred year government seal.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他的政府已将他的疫苗接种状态列为保密长达一百年的国家机密。

sentences.en: As a result, Brazil's had more than 600,000 deaths in the pandemic, which was second only to the United States.
sentences.zh: 结果，巴西在疫情中死亡人数超过了60万，仅次于美国。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: So, a lot of people are upset and about half the country is desperate for a new leader.
sentences.zh: 所以，许多人感到不满，大约半数国民极度渴望一位新领袖。

sentences.en: And then in November 2019, something big happens.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2019年11月，发生了一件大事。

sentences.en: Lula is out of prison.
sentences.zh: 卢拉出狱了。

sentences.en: So, basically, after 19 months in prison, the Supreme Court ruled that he had been tried in the wrong jurisdiction and also that the judge in his case was biased.
sentences.zh: 基本上，在入狱19个月后，最高法院裁定对他的审判管辖权有误，且其案中的法官带有偏见。

sentences.en: What this means is his convictions are nullified.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他的定罪被宣告无效。

sentences.en: It does not necessarily mean that he's been absolved or that he's been found innocent.
sentences.zh: 这并不一定意味着他被宣告无罪或被证明是清白的。

sentences.en: But it does mean that he could run for president again.
sentences.zh: 但它确实意味着他可以再次参加总统竞选。

sentences.en: And that's what he does.
sentences.zh: 而他也确实这么做了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会打碟时，你每晚都要带着300件最珍爱的宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了这样一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，摆满了美丽的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 立即在您喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 深空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想要探索下一颗恒星之外的奥秘。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅端食谱，因为我讨厌洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，助您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即访问 nytimes.com slash subscribe 订阅，享受特别优惠。

sentences.en: Okay, so Lula is out.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以卢拉出狱了。

sentences.en: And now you have this kind of incredible battle between the former president on the left and the current president on the right.
sentences.zh: 现在你看到了左翼前总统与右翼现总统之间这种不可思议的较量。

sentences.en: And it's down to the wire.
sentences.zh: 而且胜负难分，悬念将持续到最后一刻。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's pretty dramatic.
sentences.zh: 是的，相当戏剧化。

sentences.en: If you're on the left in Brazil, this is a moment where the man who lifted Brazil up is suddenly back to save it from this far-right,
sentences.zh: 如果你在巴西支持左翼，这就是那个曾让巴西崛起的男人突然归来，从这位将巴西带入歧途的极右翼、

sentences.en: dangerous president who is bringing Brazil down the wrong path.
sentences.zh: 危险的总统手中拯救国家的时刻。

sentences.en: And if you're on the right, instead, it's this ex-convict who had overseen all of this corruption for years in Brazil,
sentences.zh: 而如果你支持右翼，相反，这就是那个多年来在巴西纵容所有这些腐败的前罪犯，

sentences.en: who was suddenly trying to get out of prison and take back control of the country.
sentences.zh: 突然试图出狱并夺回国家控制权。

sentences.en: And as a result, a lot of this campaign has been pretty ugly.
sentences.zh: 结果，这场竞选的大部分内容都相当难看。

sentences.en: Just in the first debate, you know, it was not about the future of Brazil.
sentences.zh: 就在第一场辩论中，你知道的，它无关巴西的未来。

sentences.en: It was really about these two men's paSt.
sentences.zh: 它实际上关乎这两个男人的过去。

sentences.en: And at times, it devolved into Bolsonaro calling Lula an ex-convict and corrupt, and Lula saying that Bolsonaro wakes up in the morning and can't stop lying.
sentences.zh: 有时，辩论甚至演变成博索纳罗称卢拉为前罪犯和腐败分子，而卢拉则称博索纳罗早晨醒来就满嘴谎言。

sentences.en: It's your lie.
sentences.zh: 这是你的谎言。

sentences.en: It's your lie.
sentences.zh: 这是你的谎言。

sentences.en: It's my lie.
sentences.zh: 这是我的谎言。

sentences.en: It's my lie.
sentences.zh: 这是我的谎言。

sentences.en: So, Jack, you said that the debate was largely about the paSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，杰克，你刚才说辩论在很大程度上是关于过去的。

sentences.en: But what do we know about their pitches to Brazilians about the future?
sentences.zh: 但对于他们向巴西人描绘的未来愿景，我们了解多少？

sentences.en: So, there are three main issues in this campaign, I think, to start with the economy.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为这次竞选有三个主要议题，首先是经济。

sentences.en: So, Lula, you know, a traditional leftist, has pitched the public on rather vague plans to increase taxes on the rich in order to increase services for the poor.
sentences.zh: 卢拉作为一个传统的左翼人士，向公众提出了相当模糊的计划，即通过对富人加税来增加对穷人的服务。

sentences.en: He talks a lot about expanding the social welfare programs that he first introduced in his first administration, essentially increasing the minimum wage,
sentences.zh: 他经常谈到扩大他在第一任期内首次推出的社会福利项目，主要是提高最低工资，

sentences.en: trying to reduce inflation, and giving more money to those who need it from the government.
sentences.zh: 试图降低通货膨胀，并从政府那里向需要的人提供更多资金。

sentences.en: Bolsonaro, meanwhile, surprisingly, has been giving out a lot of money to the poor as well, especially recently as he's been trying to get re-elected.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，博索纳罗出人意料地也向穷人发放了大量资金，特别是在最近他试图谋求连任的时候。

sentences.en: But Bolsonaro has certainly governed as sort of a right-wing free market politician.
sentences.zh: 但博索纳罗的执政风格无疑带有某种右翼自由市场政治家的特征。

sentences.en: He has cut red tape for businesses and has really tried to deregulate and reduce the size of government.
sentences.zh: 他为企业减少了繁文缛节，并极力放松管制、精简政府规模。

sentences.en: And some people in the market and economists say that he's done a decent job around the edges with Brazil's economy in that sense.
sentences.zh: 市场上的某些人和经济学家表示，在这个意义上，他在巴西经济的边缘地带做得相当不错。

sentences.en: So, actually, in terms of campaign promises and the economy, they're actually looking pretty similar.
sentences.zh: 所以，实际上，就竞选承诺和经济而言，他们看起来非常相似。

sentences.en: The funny thing is, yes, when you look at the details, I think they're closer economically than one would imagine.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，是的，当你细看细节时，我认为他们在经济上的差距比人们想象的要小。

sentences.en: However, rhetorically, they are miles apart.
sentences.zh: 然而，在口头上，他们有着天壤之别。

sentences.en: And that is in part because Lula frames Bolsonaro as someone who is in bed with the bankers, and Bolsonaro frames Lula as a communiSt.
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于，卢拉将博索纳罗塑造为与银行家勾结的人，而博索纳罗则将卢拉塑造为共产主义者。

sentences.en: But their economic priorities bleeds into the next major issue, and that is the Amazon rainforeSt.
sentences.zh: 但他们的经济优先事项延伸到了下一个重大议题，那就是亚马逊热带雨林。

sentences.en: So, what we can say is, the four years of Bolsonaro's presidency has been very bad for the Amazon.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们可以说，博索纳罗执政的四年对亚马逊来说是非常糟糕的四年。

sentences.en: Bolsonaro has cut funding and staffing for some of the key federal agencies that are tasked with protecting the rainforest and the indigenous groups that live there.
sentences.zh: 博索纳罗削减了负责保护雨林及其中居住的原住民群体的几个关键联邦机构的资金和人员配置。

sentences.en: And he has also championed many of the industries that exploit the forests.
sentences.zh: 他还大力支持许多开发森林的产业。

sentences.en: And that has really emboldened a lot of the illegal loggers and ranchers and miners who have invaded the forests and a lot of the indigenous protected territories in order to extract wood and natural resources from the Amazon.
sentences.zh: 这实际上助长了许多非法伐木者、牧场主和矿工的嚣张气焰，他们为了从亚马逊掠夺木材和自然资源，侵入了森林和许多原住民保护区。

sentences.en: And as a result, deforestation has soared on his watch.
sentences.zh: 结果，在他任内，森林砍伐急剧飙升。

sentences.en: Yet, Bolsonaro has run on protecting the foreSt.
sentences.zh: 然而，博索纳罗的竞选纲领却是保护森林。

sentences.en: He has said that he will increase enforcement, and that really goes against what the reality has been in his administration.
sentences.zh: 他曾表示将加大执法力度，这与他政府实际上的所作所为背道而驰。

sentences.en: Lula, meanwhile, has a much better track record on the Amazon.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，卢拉在亚马逊问题上有好得多的政绩。

sentences.en: He reduced deforestation during his eight years in office, and he has run on a promise to eradicate illegal logging and mining during his administration,
sentences.zh: 他在八年任期内减少了森林砍伐，并且在竞选时承诺在其执政期间根除非法伐木和采矿，

sentences.en: though where that fits in on his priorities is not exactly clear.
sentences.zh: 尽管这在他的优先事项中占什么地位并不十分明确。

sentences.en: And how else are they different?
sentences.zh: 那他们还有什么其他不同？

sentences.en: I would say that, you know, probably the most significant difference, and really where a lot of this campaign has been focused, has been on the culture wars.
sentences.zh: 我想说，也许最显著的不同，也是这场竞选主要聚焦的地方，在于文化战争。

sentences.en: So, Bolsonaro has found that it is politically very popular for him to frame the left as a party that is trying to do away with the traditional Brazilian way of life.
sentences.zh: 因此，博索纳罗发现，将左翼描绘成一个试图消灭巴西传统生活方式的政党，在政治上非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: In fact, he generally talks less about the economy and more about protecting Brazilians from things like gender ideology or the sexualization of children, abortion,
sentences.zh: 事实上，他通常较少谈论经济，更多地谈论如何保护巴西人免受诸如性别意识形态、儿童色情化、堕胎、

sentences.en: censorship of social media, lies from the press.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体审查以及来自新闻界的谎言等事物的侵害。

sentences.en: And it's another way that the Brazilian right has begun to resemble the American right and the larger right-wing populist movement across the world.
sentences.zh: 这也是巴西右翼开始类似于美国右翼以及全球更广泛的右翼民粹主义运动的另一种方式。

sentences.en: Really relying on these hot-button cultural issues that, in a lot of ways, politicians in America rely on, too.
sentences.zh: 他们真正依赖的是这些极具争议的文化议题，在很多方面，美国的政客们也同样依赖这些议题。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's really the cornerstone of the Bolsonaro campaign and political movement, frankly.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，这确实是博索纳罗竞选活动和政治运动的基石。

sentences.en: And who supports that?
sentences.zh: 谁支持这些？

sentences.en: Who's his base?
sentences.zh: 他的基本盘是谁？

sentences.en: His base has often been described as Bibles, beef, and bullets, and that is the large evangelical population in Brazil, the large agricultural industry in the country,
sentences.zh: 他的基本盘经常被描述为圣经、牛肉和子弹，也就是巴西庞大的福音派人口、国内庞大的农业产业，

sentences.en: and also the law enforcement and military, all of which largely side with Bolsonaro, and many of whom really relate to some of these cultural issues.
sentences.zh: 还有执法部门和军方，所有这些群体在很大程度上都站在博索纳罗一边，其中许多人对其中的一些文化议题深有共鸣。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And what about for Lula?
sentences.zh: 那卢拉呢？

sentences.en: Who's his base?
sentences.zh: 他的基本盘是谁？

sentences.en: So, Lula has really built his base on the working class.
sentences.zh: 所以，卢拉确实是以工人阶级为基础建立他的基本盘的。

sentences.en: It has been his political identity from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 这是他自始至终的政治身份。

sentences.en: Brazil is a country that has a very large working class and is true to his roots as a person and as a politician.
sentences.zh: 巴西是一个拥有庞大工人阶级的国家，这符合他作为个人和政治家的根基。

sentences.en: But in this campaign, he has also succeeded in building a really wide tent from the center to the far left.
sentences.zh: 但在这次竞选中，他也成功建立了一个从中心到极左的真正广泛的阵营。

sentences.en: But now there's a big question about whether or not that coalition is still going to be enough with the sheer strength of the Bolsonaro movement.
sentences.zh: 但现在有一个巨大的疑问，鉴于博索纳罗运动的绝对实力，这个联盟是否依然足够强大。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, who's going to win?
sentences.zh: 那么，谁会赢？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, to win the presidency in Brazil, you need at least 50% of the vote.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，要在巴西赢得总统大选，你需要至少50%的选票。

sentences.en: And on October 2nd, there was a first round of voting with Bolsonaro and Lula and a number of other candidates.
sentences.zh: 在10月2日，举行了第一轮投票，参选的有博索纳罗、卢拉以及其他几位候选人。

sentences.en: And at the time, the polls had actually indicated that Lula had such a wide lead, he might even be able to surpass that 50% threshold and win the election outright.
sentences.zh: 当时，民调实际上显示卢拉拥有如此巨大的领先优势，他甚至可能跨过50%的门槛，直接赢得大选。

sentences.en: But instead, the polls were off.
sentences.zh: 但结果却是，民调失准了。

sentences.en: Bolsonaro did much better than expected, and the race went to a runoff.
sentences.zh: 博索纳罗的表现远超预期，比赛进入了决胜轮。

sentences.en: Lula still has a slight lead, but we've already seen that the polls are underestimating Bolsonaro.
sentences.zh: 卢拉仍然保持微弱领先，但我们已经看到民调低估了博索纳罗。

sentences.en: So, it comes down to Sunday, and it's really too close to call right now.
sentences.zh: 所以悬念留到了周日，现在局势确实难分难解。

sentences.en: So, what happens if Bolsonaro wins?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果博索纳罗赢了会发生什么？

sentences.en: If Bolsonaro wins, he's going to be emboldened and with a new mandate to carry out many of the same policies that he started in the first term.
sentences.zh: 如果博索纳罗获胜，他将受到鼓舞，并获得新的授权来推行他在第一任期开始时的许多相同政策。

sentences.en: And he's going to have much more power.
sentences.zh: 而且他将拥有更大的权力。

sentences.en: And that's because his party won the most seats in Congress in the first round.
sentences.zh: 这是因为他的政党在第一轮投票中赢得了国会中最多的席位。

sentences.en: And he's now going to have even more control over the different branches of government.
sentences.zh: 他现在将对政府各个部门拥有更多的控制权。

sentences.en: And there will also be a sense of vindication.
sentences.zh: 这也将带来一种沉冤得雪的感觉。

sentences.en: After he had told everyone that the polls were underestimating him, that people were counting him out,
sentences.zh: 在他告诉所有人民调低估了他、人们在看扁他之后，

sentences.en: now he's back for a second term, and it means that the Brazilian people like his brand of governing.
sentences.zh: 现在他迎来了第二个任期，这意味着巴西人民喜欢他这种执政风格。

sentences.en: Okay, so what about the flip side?
sentences.zh: 好的，那反过来呢？

sentences.en: Say Bolsonaro loses.
sentences.zh: 假设博索纳罗输了。

sentences.en: Well, that has the potential for a darker scenario.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这有可能引发一个更黑暗的剧本。

sentences.en: So, for almost eight years, Bolsonaro has been casting doubt on Brazil's election systeMs.
sentences.zh: 近八年来，博索纳罗一直在对巴西的选举制度表示怀疑。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: Brazil uses electronic voting machines.
sentences.zh: 巴西使用的是电子投票机。

sentences.en: It's actually the only country in the world to use a fully digital system without paper backups.
sentences.zh: 它实际上是世界上唯一一个完全使用没有纸质备份的数字系统的国家。

sentences.en: And to Bolsonaro, that is a fatal flaw in the system.
sentences.zh: 对博索纳罗来说，这是该系统的一个致命缺陷。

sentences.en: He says it's impossible to audit, and therefore, it's impossible to know whether or not there was fraud.
sentences.zh: 他说这无法审计，因此无法得知是否存在欺诈。

sentences.en: So, for years and years, he has questioned the reliability of the elections.
sentences.zh: 所以多年来，他一直对选举的可靠性提出质疑。

sentences.en: And he has really relied upon anecdotal evidence and inaccuracies and, frankly, downright falsehoods.
sentences.zh: 他真正依赖的是轶事证据、不准确的信息，坦率地说，还有彻头彻尾的谎言。

sentences.en: Much like Trump in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 很像美国的特朗普。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And it seems to have worked.
sentences.zh: 这似乎起作用了。

sentences.en: Only a little or not at all, after years and years of Bolsonaro's rhetoric against them.
sentences.zh: 在博索纳罗多年针对它们的言论之后，只有少数人或根本没有人（信任它们）。

sentences.en: And given the fact that the election has now tightened, it could mean that we have a scenario in which Bolsonaro narrowly loses the election and refuses to accept it.
sentences.zh: 鉴于目前的选情已经陷入胶着，这可能意味着会出现这样一种情况：博索纳罗以微弱劣势输掉大选并拒绝接受结果。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: The concern in Brazil and in the international community is that millions of his supporters then go along with his attempts to hold on to power.
sentences.zh: 巴西国内和国际社会的担忧在于，他的数百万支持者随后会随他一起试图把持权力。

sentences.en: And Bolsonaro has refused to say outright that he would accept the results of the election.
sentences.zh: 博索纳罗一直拒绝明确表示他会接受选举结果。

sentences.en: Always hedging, he would only accept a clean election.
sentences.zh: 他总是含糊其辞，声称只接受一场干净的选举。

sentences.en: And at times, he has had even more worrisome rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 有时，他的言论甚至更加令人担忧。

sentences.en: Last year, for instance, to an enormous crowd in Sao Paulo, he said there were only going to be three outcomes to this election.
sentences.zh: 例如去年，在圣保罗面对庞大的群众时，他称这次选举只有三种结局。

sentences.en: He would be either arrested, killed, or re-elected.
sentences.zh: 他要么被捕、被杀，要么就是连任。

sentences.en: So, what are people saying about what might happen?
sentences.zh: 那么人们对可能发生的事情是怎么看的？

sentences.en: I mean, you know, we all remember January 6th, of course, and what denying the results of an election can lead to.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道的，我们当然都记得1月6日，以及否定选举结果会带来什么后果。

sentences.en: What's the thinking in Brazil?
sentences.zh: 巴西各界是怎么想的？

sentences.en: Well, the good thing is that it appears that Brazil's democratic institutions are prepared to reject any attempts to hold on to power.
sentences.zh: 嗯，好消息是，巴西的民主机构似乎已经准备好拒绝任何把持权力的企图。

sentences.en: That includes the Congress, the Supreme Court, election officials.
sentences.zh: 这包括国会、最高法院和选举官员。

sentences.en: But it appears that many of his supporters are prepared to fight.
sentences.zh: 但他的许多支持者似乎也做好了战斗的准备。

sentences.en: But over the campaign, I've traveled the country and talked to dozens and dozens of his supporters.
sentences.zh: 但在整个竞选期间，我走访了全国各地，与他的数十甚至上百名支持者交谈过。

sentences.en: And nearly all of them are convinced that if he loses, it will only be because of fraud.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有人都坚信，如果他输了，那一定是因为存在欺诈。

sentences.en: And many of them are preparing to go to the nation's capital to protest in the event of a loss.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人正准备在落败的情况下前往首都进行抗议。

sentences.en: And so, people are really worried about a scenario that does resemble January 6th.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们确实在担心一种类似于1月6日国会山骚乱的情景。

sentences.en: And we're going to have to see next week what happens.
sentences.zh: 我们下周得看看情况会怎样。

sentences.en: So, it really sounds like the stakes of this election could not be higher.
sentences.zh: 所以，听上去这次选举的利害关系再重大不过了。

sentences.en: I mean, at the risk of kind of overstating it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，冒着有点夸大其词的风险来说。

sentences.en: It's like, can Brazilian democracy survive it?
sentences.zh: 就像是，巴西的民主能挺过这一关吗？

sentences.en: Yes, this is more than just a typical election of two starkly opposed politicians.
sentences.zh: 是的，这不仅仅是一场两位立场截然相反的政客的典型选举。

sentences.en: It is not only about the future of the country economically and socially, but also about the future of the democracy.
sentences.zh: 它不仅关乎国家经济和社会的未来，也关乎民主的未来。

sentences.en: And, you know, remember that we're talking about, you know, the Amazon rainforest, perhaps the most important biome on the planet.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，别忘了我们谈论的是，亚马逊雨林，这或许是地球上最重要的生物群落。

sentences.en: And that means there are high stakes for Brazil, but also really high stakes for the planet.
sentences.zh: 这意味着这对巴西有着重大影响，对整个地球来说也意义重大。

sentences.en: So, Jack, thinking about everything you've said and taking a step way back here,
sentences.zh: 所以，杰克，结合你所说的一切，我们把目光放得更长远一些，

sentences.en: it sounds like half the population in Brazil leans left and is pretty nostalgic for the time that Brazil was booming and the government was spending a lot to help the poor and Brazil had gained this huge stature on the world stage.
sentences.zh: 听起来巴西有一半人口倾向左翼，对巴西经济腾飞、政府大举资助穷人、巴西在世界舞台上声誉大噪的时期有着相当的怀念。

sentences.en: And the other half of the population leans right and they are pretty distrustful of institutions and they want a Brazil that puts these cultural issues you've been telling us about front and center.
sentences.zh: 而另一半人口则倾向右翼，他们对体制深表不信任，希望看到一个将你刚才提到的这些文化议题置于核心地位的巴西。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: The country is deeply split.
sentences.zh: 这个国家严重分裂。

sentences.en: And neither of these men have really presented clear visions for lifting Brazil out of what has been a lost decade.
sentences.zh: 而且这两位男士都没有真正提出清晰的愿景，来让巴西摆脱这已经过去的“失落十年”。

sentences.en: And as a result, it appears that the path forward is really trying to manage.
sentences.zh: 因此，未来的道路似乎真的只是在勉强应对。

sentences.en: You know, Bolsonaro is talking about protecting the social values of the country.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，博索纳罗在谈论保护国家的社会价值观。

sentences.en: And Lula is talking about making sure people get three meals.
sentences.zh: 而卢拉在谈论确保人们吃饱三顿饭。

sentences.en: There is no longer a vision for Brazil that is about a new path forward and becoming a global power.
sentences.zh: 不再有一个关于巴西的新发展道路和成为全球大国的愿景。

sentences.en: It's more about getting by.
sentences.zh: 更多的是关于得过且过。

sentences.en: And I think that's been striking in this election, that this is not the Brazil that won the Olympics.
sentences.zh: 我认为这次选举中最显眼的一点就是，这已经不是那个赢得奥运主办权的巴西了。

sentences.en: It is the Brazil that is in a different position and is now choosing between two men who are really about the past in this country,
sentences.zh: 这是一个处境不同的巴西，现在正在两个真正代表这个国家过去的男人之间做选择，

sentences.en: which has been difficult and not so much about the future.
sentences.zh: 那段过去充满坎坷，而这很大程度上与未来无关。

sentences.en: Jack, thank you.
sentences.zh: 杰克，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 纽约时报的游戏是由刚才你听到的人们制作的。

sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 从今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的新闻。

sentences.en: A series of polls conducted by the Times in four swing congressional districts offer new evidence that Republicans are poised to retake control of the House of Representatives in next month's midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 《时报》在四个摇摆国会选区进行的系列民意调查提供了新的证据，表明共和党人在下个月的中期选举中很有可能重新夺回众议院的控制权。

sentences.en: The poll found that voters in three of the four districts are more focused on economic issues than on social ones,
sentences.zh: 民调发现，这四个选区中有三个选区的选民更关注经济问题而非社会问题，

sentences.en: and that the vast majority of voters worried about the economy plan to vote for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 并且绝大多数担心经济的选民都计划投票给共和党。

sentences.en: And the Times reports that as Elon Musk begins his $44 billion takeover of Twitter, a deal he sought to abandon, but is now embraced,
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，正当埃隆·马斯克开始他对推特440亿美元的收购时——这是一笔他曾试图放弃但现在已经接受的交易，

sentences.en: he's begun to purge the company's top executives.
sentences.zh: 他已经开始清洗公司的顶级高管。

sentences.en: Musk, who closed the deal Thursday night, has fired at least four top executives, including Twitter's chief executive officer, its chief financial officer, and its top lawyer.
sentences.zh: 在周四晚完成交易的马斯克已经解雇了至少四位高管，包括推特的首席执行官、首席财务官和顶级法律顾问。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗谢尔·邦贾和埃里克·克鲁普克制作。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由来自 Wonderly 的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹沃克创作。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运转，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了推选出一批自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《Metro》节目中，由我萨拉·科尼格为您讲述人们试图保持影响力却在途中失去控制的故事。
